baseline: Uniform radio choice is 0.2; tied cue strategies split their vote. No tested cue is reliable within any equation form. Small delivered samples are coverage checks, not statistical proof. Larger 40-per-form pure-bank probes are bank-probes-before.json.
selection_limits: Read question_selection.rs: selects fresh usable candidates by difficulty then a uniform within-band index, or smallest entity with no configured policy. Captured inventory delivery exercised; live learner history, policy and future entity IDs unavailable. No database writes.
generation_order: Equation form is selected first. Its coefficients and eligible points determine the lawful slope roles; these cannot be independently assigned arbitrary triples (e.g. a*y²/x constrains signs). The sampler does not freeze source signs, target positions or horizontal-segment locations. Incidental choice order is sampled last.
fixed_choice_count_reason: One diagram selection from five choices preserves the captured radio contract; it provides no correct-option cue.
coverage_limits: The 240 pure-bank cases sample normal easy support before rendering; 51 complete records, 45 delivered semantic instances exercise controls and profiles. This is bounded evidence, not exhaustive parameter or shortcut proof. All six normal equation forms survive filtering. Source profiles are explicit replay/generalization paths, not selected by normal CLI sampling. Other bands remain preserved but are outside this easy repair validation.
